description: Module-level orchestrating function (distinct from SteamStoreClient.fetch_app_details, the per-app HTTP call) that rate-limits and iterates appdetails fetches over every candidate appid, yielding RawPayload objects for persistence.
signature: def fetch_app_details(client: SteamStoreClient, appids: Sequence[int], *, on_event: EventSink) -> Iterator[RawPayload]
docstring:
Fetch appdetails for every candidate appid.

Args:
    client: A SteamStoreClient wrapping a RateLimiter-guarded HttpClient.
    appids: FunnelResult.candidates['appid'].tolist(), the survivors of coarse_filter.
    on_event: Progress sink; emits a 'fetch_progress' event roughly every N appids (implementation-chosen batch size) with progress = completed / len(appids), plus a 'warning' event for each individual failed appid so failures are visible in the run log without aborting the batch.

Yields:
    One RawPayload(source='steam_appdetails', appid=..., http_status=..., payload=...) per appid attempted, including failures (payload with success=false, or a transport-error wrapper), per the invariant 'a failed per-app fetch degrades that app, never the run'.

Calls client's own RateLimiter.acquire() once per appid before each request (via SteamStoreClient's internal client, per AcquisitionConfig.steam_requests_per_minute).
preconditions: appids contains only positive integers, deduplicated by the caller (FunnelResult.candidates already has unique appid)
postconditions: Exactly one RawPayload is yielded per input appid, success or failure -- no appid is silently skipped
The function itself never raises for an individual app-level failure; it only raises for a budget exhaustion (RequestBudgetExceeded) or an unrecoverable client-level error

edge_cases.input: appids is empty (coarse filter produced zero candidates)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: yields nothing, emits a single 'warning' event, does not raise -- consistent with the acquisition module's 'empty candidate set after coarse filter' edge case

propagates RequestBudgetExceeded, stopping the generator; already-yielded RawPayload objects for earlier appids in this call remain valid and (if the caller persists incrementally via storage.upsert_raw_payloads in batches) are not lost

edge_cases.input: A single appid's fetch returns success=false
edge_cases.expected_behavior: yielded as a RawPayload with that payload verbatim; counted as detail_failed by the caller (run_acquisition), not raised as an exception here

unit_tests.name: test_yields_one_payload_per_appid_including_failures
unit_tests.description: 10 appids, 2 of which are stubbed to return success=false, yields exactly 10 RawPayload objects.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_appids_yields_nothing_without_raising
unit_tests.description: An empty appids sequence yields an empty iterator and emits one warning event.

unit_tests.name: test_budget_exhaustion_propagates
unit_tests.description: A RateLimiter with request_budget=3 and 10 appids raises RequestBudgetExceeded after yielding 3 payloads.
